messages.text: On the 40t , if we add more fans on the intake side , and we manage to keep temperature of the miner in the acceptable ok range , will its still void the warranty ?

Short answer: it depends on where the fans go. Extra fans sitting outside the unit, blowing into the intake, are just airflow. That is not a modification and it is not something we hold against a warranty claim. What does void it is opening the unit, replacing or rewiring the stock fans, or running overclocked or modified firmware, even if temps look fine.

Which were you planning, external fans next to it, or swapping the ones on the 40T?
Addind 2 noctua 140mm on the intake fan to bring positive static pressure in , wihtout opening the units .

That's fine. Two Noctuas pushing air at the intake, unit sealed and on stock firmware at stock clocks, keeps the warranty intact. Just don't block the exhaust side, and leave the unit's own fan curve alone.

The 40T is $799, 40 TH/s, 650 W at the wall, Batch 8, ships December 7, 2026. Want me to set up a cart?
Im asking can it said if we run 50th it void the warranty

Yes. Running it at 50 TH/s is an overclock, and overclocked or modified units aren't covered by warranty, RMA or replacement, however good your temps are. Cooling doesn't buy you an exception.

Stock, the 40T is rated 40 TH/s at 650 W. Keep it there and your extra intake fans are no problem at all.
Even on the ouside of the unit ?

The fans outside are fine either way. What voids it is the clock, not the cooling. Push the firmware to 50 TH/s and it's out of warranty even with Noctuas bolted to the front; leave it at 40 and you can cool it however you like.
